title: Beatdown Box Set: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: As insubstantial, and as powerful, as the wind that carries it.
Students who had seen Rayne argue with Urza were certain she had summoned it to make him seem warmer by comparison.
"I reeled from the blow, and then suddenly, I knew exactly what to do. Within moments victory was mine." —Gustha Ebbasdotter Kjeldoran royal mage
As elusive as the footprint of a djinn —Suq'Ata expression
"You know you've angered the gods when the clouds turn against you." —Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*
"I've seen fog so thick you could cut it, but none that could cut me." —Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*
"It's hard to hurt anyone when you're as transparent as your motives." —Ertai, wizard adept
During the giant crabs' mating season, Skyshroud nights are filled with the clatter of their skirmishes.
"Controlling time ensures you need never look impulsive again." —Teferi
Hunger is like the sea: deep, endless, and unforgiving.
Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.
Drakes claim to be dragons—until the dragons show up.
Afterward, Tolaria's winds were like the whispers of lost wizards, calling for life.
Awake and awing in the blink of an eye.
"no home no heart no hope" —Stronghold graffito
"Only fools believe they will face my armies but once." —Kaervek
"There's very little that escapes me, Greven. And you will escape very little if you fail." —Volrath
For a sharp second, Selenia froze, and Crovax's blade found home, As the angel shattered like glass, Crovax felt his mind collapse—the curse had been fulfilled.
Greven *il*-Vec lifted Vhati off his feet. "The fall will give you time to think on your failure."
"Angels are simply extensions of truth upon the fabric of life—and there is far more dark than light." —Baron Sengir
"The nightstalkers are such a minor power in Urborg. Their sad eagerness to elevate themselves makes them willing tools in the plundering of little Femeref." —Kaervek
A full coffin is like a full coffer—both are attractive to thieves.
A hollow dog is never empty. It is filled with thirst for the hunt.
"This monstrosity will do—for now." —Davvol, Evincar of Rath
The imps' warbling cries echo through Phyrexia's towers like those of mourning doves in a cathedral.
"The cyclops shrugged off savage blows, but casual insults made him weep." —Azeworai, "The Cyclops who Couldn't"
"He's big an' dumb an' ready to fight. A lot like ol' Hornhead here." —Squee, goblin cabin hand, scouting report
Anyone can get around a cyclops, but few can stand in its way.
"Catch!"
"Faugh!" snorted Tahngarth. "Why would it make a meal of something like you?" Squee looked relieved. "No," he continued, "you'd make a much better toothpick."
He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.
Lightning tethers souls to the world. —Kor saying
Music scythes the savage beast.
Don't insult a Talruum unless your mount is swift. —Suq'Ata saying
"Most wizards consider a thunderbolt to be a proper retort." —Ertai, wizard adept
The giant was felt a few seconds before he was seen.
"When traveling the Great Desert avoid wearing the scales of lizards, for the Viashino rule the sands and look poorly on the skinning of their cousins." —Zhalfirin Guide to the Desert
Love is like a rhino, short-sighted and hasty; if it cannot find a way, it will make a way. —Femeref adage
Bores ruin a party. Boars are party to ruin.
With his newfound sense of self-importance, Squee set his sights on ever-bigger bugs.
One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot. —Llanowar penalty for trespassing
Most spiders wait patiently for their prey to arrive. Most spiders aren't forty feet tall.
Rath forces plants from its surface as one presses whey from cheese.

"Flourishing during the Ice Age, these wurms were the bane of all Kjeldorans. Their great size and ferocity made them the subject of countless nightmares—they embodied the worst of the Ice Age." —*Kjeldor: Ice Civilization*
Freyalise forbid that any stranger should wander into the striders' territory.
"We need not fear the forces of the air; I've yet to see a spider without an appetite." —Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter
When the gorilla playfully grabbed the wurm's tail, the wurm doubled back and playfully ate the gorilla's head.
"I have seen the true path. I will not warm myself by the fire—I will become the flame." —Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer
"If only we could so easily leave behind those parts of ourselves that pain us." —Crovax
